note: Thomas County fairgrounds RV area in Colby: back-in grass sites sharing full-hookup posts, self-pay (checks preferred, per a camper). Ruts and mud after rain; rates rise and the grounds are busy during events (fair week late July, rodeos, races, festivals). --Claude
summary: Fair Board page (c)2026 confirms $30 full service / $20 dry / weekly & monthly; nightly rentals outside events (campers paid $30 May-Oct 2026). Fees now 20/30; electric 50, year-round and dump cleared (unsourced).
flags: PHONE: stored 785-443-5459 is not on the Fair Board site. The site lists the Fair Board 785-460-4593 and the grounds keeper 785-443-2217 (the contact printed beside the campground rates). Suggest 785-443-2217; a 2026 camper reports no answer on a Saturday.

EVENTS: the site posts no camping closures. Ordinary nights are rented outside events (five 2026 stays May-October). A June 2026 camper paid $35 during a bluegrass festival; fair week is 27 July - 1 August 2026 with rodeo, races and demo derby on the grounds.
MONTHLY RATES: $500/month full service and $350/month dry are posted. The 2026 reviews describe overnight stops and nobody mentions residents; long-stay tests not triggered.
SITE COUNT: not stated by the Fair Board; imagery shows a row of about 10-12 RVs on grass west of the north entrance road; a camper reports site 10. Left unset.
PIN 39.39239,-101.0567 sits at the RV row's east end beside the entrance road (imagery 2026-11-06); OK.
SURFACE: grass sites, 'rutted', 'soggy'/'messy' after rain (two 2026 reviews). Not a sand-rule case.
